key_insight: WorkflowView uses large language models to convert noisy, low-level action logs into interpretable high-level workflows that transfer across domains.
engineering_relevance: This enables product and platform teams to derive actionable user-behavior insights from existing telemetry without building domain-specific sequence models.
method: Apply LLMs to abstract action sequences into activity-level descriptions
Test zero-shot reconstruction of browser tasks and few-shot MOOC dropout prediction
Use anonymized workflow analysis for privacy-preserving insight into AI tool use in Microsoft Word
evidence_signal: The approach achieved high semantic similarity for task reconstruction (mu_sim = 0.91) and strong few-shot dropout prediction performance (weighted F1 = 0.90 with five examples).
watch_item: LLM-based inference in logging pipelines must balance computational cost with privacy and deployment constraints.
paper_title: Abstracting Cross-Domain Action Sequences into Interpretable Workflows
